trust_radius_rule: Choose the largest tested absolute dose satisfying every protected limit jointly across every frozen Stage-A direction, matched-other form, sign, and audit-control form. If no dose passes, report that the next optimizer has no empirically supported positive trust radius on this grid.
outcome_use: The trust-radius rule uses only protected matched-other and unrelated-task outcomes. Self-target outcomes are reported but cannot select the radius.
claim_boundary: These prompts and directions were already opened. This probe may set a development safety radius but cannot validate efficacy, support a publication effect estimate, or rescue the failed v3 result.
